amendments: AMENDMENT-01: ADD harness/drive_cap.sh + harness/capture_cap.sh -- a process-group wall-clock cap. perl alarm + exec kills only the shell and ORPHANS the python child. Frozen before stage 6A's first dispatch; phases 1-3 keep drive_one.sh/capture.sh unchanged and are not re-scored.

AMENDMENT-02: ADD phase 6, one cold-device capture of tex_write@twdyn/0 after a declared >=35 min idle. Designed AFTER seeing phase 1/5 data; explicitly NOT Gate E evidence; changes no pair designation, budget, exclusion or verdict.

AMENDMENT-03: ADD a device-health gate (harness/health_gate.py) that must pass before any further capture, after stage 6B drove EXP-0206's abort-path-free run.py into a self-inflicted hang cascade that outlived the capture and hung the NEXT capture's carrier_open. Adds a conjunct that can fail; changes no verdict.

AMENDMENT-04: ADD one 900 s-capped cascade-threshold probe on ret_luse.linkmode@cl_atomic, to test whether stage 6B's measured ~20-hang cascade onset generalises to a second arm family. NOT Gate E; does NOT reach stage 6C, which stays NOT REACHED.

AMENDMENT-05: RE-CAPTURE stage 6C under NEW run ids (L3/L4). The AMENDMENT-04 threshold probe refuted the premise on which 6C was stopped: ret_luse.linkmode hangs ARE driver-recoverable (225 resets, no cascade over 149 values) unlike if_push.scope@cf_nl2+106's, which reset nothing and accumulate. L1_cl_atomic retained, never reused.
clean_room: HW-PROBE: re-running our OWN committed harnesses over shaders compiled from our OWN MSL, plus black-box IOKit registry PROPERTY reads. No Apple binary is disassembled, decompiled, symbol-dumped or otherwise introspected.

key ret_luse.linkmode on cl_atomic, cl_leaf, cl_chain

gate_note: Captures are validated against repo_revision recorded HERE, not against live HEAD. A sibling experiment landing is not contamination (SUBAGENT_BRIEF; EXP-0082).

EXP-0204.source: the harness's own frozen values, UNCHANGED
EXP-0204.tex_deriv_claim_domain: the 56 non-hazard values of the frozen 65-value sample

EXP-0206.source: declared HERE; EXP-0206's run.py deliberately has no abort path and that is not changed. The cap is enforced by an EXTERNAL alarm wrapper.

pull_policy: one run directory at a time via harness/pull_run.sh, which REFUSES a pull onto an existing local directory. No tree-wide rsync/tar pull (EXP-0210 disclosed that one overwrote a committed raw file).

quiet_gate.criterion: Q1 zero LIVE foreign dispatch runners in every sample AND Q3 no foreign submitter AND Q4 sampler alive AND zero ioreg errors
quiet_gate.device_counters_per_capture: gpusnap.py pre and post, plus every 2 s sample
not_gated_reported_only: recoveryCount delta (EXP-0210 AMENDMENT-03: a gate no fault-heavy capture can pass)
MTLCompilerService count (launchd-owned XPC, does not dispatch)
exiting/parenthesised-comm foreign rows (zombies hold no GPU context)

stop_rules: neo unresponsive -> STOP and report BLOCKED; macvdmtool is forbidden here
a stage exceeding its cap is not retried; its pair is NOT REACHED
